description:
Window Manager arranges macOS windows with configurable keyboard shortcuts and drag-to-edge snap areas. Move windows into halves, corners, thirds, fourths, and sixths; move them between displays; center, maximize, resize, and restore them.

Window Manager runs locally. It does not include analytics, advertising, account sign-in, or a network update service.
promotionalText: Arrange windows quickly with keyboard shortcuts and drag-to-edge snapping.
